entry.title: Copilot goes multiplayer: Autopilot and Workspaces #msignite

media:group.media:title: Copilot goes multiplayer: Autopilot and Workspaces #msignite
media:group.media:description: At Microsoft Ignite, Jacob Andreou shares how the next chapter of Copilot is about collaboration between people and agents. Autopilot can take on recurring work and follow-ups, while Copilot Workspaces gives teams and agents a shared place to build, review, and move projects forward. Autopilot is starting its Frontier rollout, and Workspaces is now available in Frontier.

entry.title: Her cancer was 1 of 300 types, Azure helped find it | Children's Cancer Institute

media:group.media:title: Her cancer was 1 of 300 types, Azure helped find it | Children's Cancer Institute
media:group.media:description:
When newborn Scout Bradstreet was diagnosed with an aggressive brain tumor, Children's Cancer Institute used genomic analysis and Microsoft Azure to identify a targeted therapy that changed her life.
Today, Scout is thriving—a result made possible by the Institute’s advanced, data-driven approach.
Processing nearly a terabyte of data per patient for ~25 patients each week, the Institute uses Azure to reduce 5,000 hours of computation to less than 24 hours, accelerating precision medicine and delivering faster, more personalized cancer care.

entry.title: How TK Elevator technicians use agentic AI to prepare for every job

media:group.media:title: How TK Elevator technicians use agentic AI to prepare for every job
media:group.media:description:
TK Elevator is using agentic AI, created with Azure AI Foundry and Azure Databricks, to brief its service technicians before they reach the elevator and capture what they learn through a voice debriefing agent. Paired with insights from its Digital Operations Centers, the agents help technicians arrive better prepared for jobs while capturing and sharing knowledge with colleagues around the world.
Learn more - https://aka.ms/GerHero27

entry.title: How NHS ambulance teams are using Microsoft Copilot to rethink patient pathways

media:group.media:title: How NHS ambulance teams are using Microsoft Copilot to rethink patient pathways
media:group.media:description:
Yorkshire Ambulance Service, part of England's National Health Service (NHS) is using Microsoft Copilot to bring together data from multiple systems, helping teams understand patterns and identify opportunities across patient pathways. In Rotherham, the proportion of ambulance journeys ending at an emergency department fell from the mid-60% range to 56%.
Learn more - https://aka.ms/NHS27

entry.title: How agentic discovery can help the construction industry reduce its carbon footprint

media:group.media:title: How agentic discovery can help the construction industry reduce its carbon footprint
media:group.media:description:
Researchers at Saint-Gobain are using Microsoft Discovery to accelerate scientific research and identify promising new molecules for cement additives. The goal is to develop stronger, lower-carbon cement by reducing the need for clinker, a major source of emissions in cement production.
Learn more - https://aka.ms/FrSG27
